title: dropdown ok narrow middle
name: Dropdown OK narrow middle — NN/g
rule: Dropdown OK in a narrow middle (~5–10) when the field is secondary or compactness matters.

citation.source: NN/g — Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List?

pass_when: A ~5–10 secondary/compact field may use a dropdown.
fail_when: Treating “dropdown never” or “dropdown always” as the rule for this middle band.
overview: Dropdown is acceptable for a secondary ~5–10 option compact field.
apply_when: Secondary or compact field with roughly five to ten options.
not_when: Treating dropdown as never or always for this middle band.
agent_hint: Allow dropdown for secondary ~5–10 options; reject absolute never/always rules.
description: In the narrow middle band of about five to ten choices, a dropdown can be fine when the field is secondary or compactness matters. Pass when that secondary or compact field uses a dropdown. Fail when the design treats “dropdown never” or “dropdown always” as the rule for this band instead of judging secondary use and compactness.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK select-last-resort as a winner over this band.
